parsed.modern: Horos is also a thick rope, extended in a perpendicular line direction near east four or after field at each if, the purpose of boiling or extending force fall upon it. When it is fixed before a mast, it is calculated for the use of a fall called the former folk, whole you'd being attached to the horse, by means of a traveler or bull's eye, which slides up and down occasionally, is retained in a likely position where when the fail is set, or whilst it is holding or lowering. When the horse is places itself or behind a mast, it is intended for the crystal of a few, and is according to party fixed in this position, except in those floors of war which occasionally assume the form of flows, in order to deceive the enemy.
